summary: The review base is now `feat/staging-sign-in-allowlist`. The sign-in allowlist (hooks, `stillAllowed`, `SignInAllowlist`) belongs to that base, so this diff only adds the production staging-testers flag and the desktop menu toggle. The base already fixes F1 and F2: a read failure now returns an error instead of signing users out, and refreshes are shared, time out after 5 s and back off after failures. F3 is out of scope here, and the e2e test now covers the `signIn` branch from F4. All temp tests pass, every changed line is covered, and no P0 or P1 issue remains.
